hooks.name: claim-lint-on-save
hooks.description: Keep every saved source file and doc inside the claim rules in .kiro/steering/claims.md

action.prompt: A file under src/ or docs/ was just saved. Run `python3 scripts/refresh_numbers.py --lint-only`. If it reports any problem, fix the wording at each reported file:line so it follows .kiro/steering/claims.md (for example 'median among closed cases' instead of a phrase calling it the city's figure, and 'closed as Noted or Transitioned' instead of saying cases were unfixed), then rerun the lint until it reports 0 problems. Do not weaken or delete the lint patterns in scripts/refresh_numbers.py to make it pass.
